title: Defense Tackling module and KPI strip, revision 2
approvalNote: Revises the Tackling module of reports.missed-tackles: Total Tackles, Missed Tackles, Missed Tackle rate (misses / (tackles + misses) over snaps with a count charted), Plays with a Missed Tackle, Yards / play with and without; Season vs Last 3 shows the rate. The Defense KPI strip has eleven centered tiles: Missed Tackles after Explosive Plays Allowed.
productionNote: Built 2026-10-07. One departure, decided by the coach: eleven tiles fit the widest value (100.0%) at full size only from 1640px, so the strip wraps to six then five below 1640 instead of shrinking type. Installed smoke pending.
